P.name: Surging Tides
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Nami's''' {{tip|abilities}} grant {{sti|ms|{{as|100|ms}}}} {{as|(+ 25% AP)}} {{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}} to allied {{tip|champions}} hit, decaying over {{fd|1.5}} seconds. The bonus is{{ft|doubled|increased to {{as|200|ms}} {{as|(+ 50% AP)}}}}from ''{{ai|Tidal Wave|Nami}}''.

Q.name: Aqua Prison
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Nami''' launches a bubble at the target location that lands {{tt|after {{rutngt|0.7}}|after the cast time ends}}, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit and {{tip|suspension|suspending}} them for {{fd|1.5}} seconds, during which they are {{tip|standard sight|revealed}}.
Q.description2: ''Allied champions are granted {{ai|Surging Tides|Nami}} in a slightly larger area.''

W.name: Ebb and Flow
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Nami''' unleashes a stream of water onto the target champion or herself, which then bounces to nearby unaffected champions up to twice, alternating between enemies and allies and '''Nami'''.
W.description2: ''Ebb and Flow'' {{tip|Heal|heals}} allies and deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies, with each bounce modifying the effectiveness of the next by -20% {{as|(+ 15% per 100 AP)}}.

E.name: Tidecaller's Blessing
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Nami''' blesses herself or an allied champion for 6 seconds, empowering their next 3 [[basic attack]]s or [[champion ability|abilities]] to each deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} and {{tip|slow}} enemies for 1 second.
E.leveling:
{{st|Bonus Magic Damage Per Hit|{{ap|20 to 80}} {{as|(+ 20% AP)}}|Total Bonus Magic Damage|{{ap|20*3 to 80*3}} {{as|(+ 60% AP)}}}}
{{st|Slow|{{ap|15 to 35}}% {{as|(+ 5% per 100 AP)}}}}
E.description2: Empowered abilities that apply {{tip|area damage}} only deal {{pp|key=%|33 to 66}} of the '''bonus''' damage to non-champions.

R.name: Tidal Wave
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Nami''' surges a tidal wave in the target direction, granting {{tip|sight}} around its trajectory as it travels, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit, {{tip|airborne|knocking them up}} for {{tt|{{fd|0.5}}|Estimated}} seconds, and {{tip|slow|slowing}} them by 70% for {{pp|type=distance traveled|2 to 4 by 0.2|0 to 2750|formula = ''Capped at 2750 range.''}} seconds.
